title: The Sales Representative list looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "card-04-n1-list.png" (board 1.4) and "card-15-n1-unassign-list.png" (board 1.15) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the work order in that browser window.
custom_steps:
1. Click the field and compare the open list with the picture of board 1.4.
  2. Click sales rep A in the list.
  3. Open the list again and compare with the picture of board 1.15.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list opens under the field.
  • "Unassigned" is first and checked, then the representatives.
  • There is no search box.
  • The list looks as in the picture.

Step 2:

  • The field reads sales rep A.

Step 3:

  • Sales rep A is the checked option.
  • "Unassigned" is still first, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-R8: “Clicking the field opens a dropdown. Its first option is "Unassigned", followed by every active sales representative, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z.”
  • S1-R9: “The option for the person in the field is checked. With nobody assigned, "Unassigned" is checked.”
  • S1-R12: “The dropdown has no search box.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
